name: (02) Thaumaturgy (The Green Path) — 1 Basic — Speed the Season's Passing

system.description:
With a touch the thaumaturge races a plant through its seasons, coaxing a bloom from a seed in minutes or withering a stake to crumbling dust.

Touch the target plant and activate the power to greatly accelerate its growth or decay. Spend a Willpower Trait for a near-instant effect, such as sprouting fruit in minutes or, in combat, crumbling a stake or other wooden weapon into useless dust. You cannot use this power while you yourself are staked. Retest with Occult.
